description:
Context: packages/preflight/lib/checks.mjs creates preflight-test-branch in checkBranch and .worktrees/preflight-test in checkWorktrees, then deletes them in a finally block that swallows cleanup errors and still returns pass.
Requirements:
1. In checkBranch and checkWorktrees (packages/preflight/lib/checks.mjs), reap any pre-existing leftover preflight-test-branch or .worktrees/preflight-test before creating the test artifact so a leaked artifact self-heals on the next preflight run.
2. Retry cleanup on transient failure and, if cleanup still fails, return status: fail with a clear diagnostic rather than reporting pass ("created and removed").
3. Add unit tests in packages/preflight/test/unit.test.mjs covering pre-existing branch/worktree self-healing and cleanup-failure reporting.
title: fix(preflight): reap stale test branch/worktree and fail if cleanup fails (#496)
